facts.fact: The policy text says the Government of Lesotho 'hereby adopts' the National Digital Policy 2024 as a framework for economic growth and digitised government services, though its approval date is left as a blank placeholder; the published date is used.
The policy is held on the government site and sets its vision for 2035, a 2024-2035 span with a major review in 2030 and a renewal around 2035, so the document date falls inside its period.
The policy carries a high-level implementation table with dated phases from 2024-2025 to 2034-2035 and no costs.

The policy designates the ICT minister as Chief Digital Officer and national digital transformation lead, and commits government to set up a Chief Digital Office, a statutory National Digital Advisory Council and a National Digital Agency to implement it.

The policy says ITU technical assistance was used to draft the National Digital Transformation Strategy: Agenda 2030, and its implementation table lists 'completion and adoption' of that strategy as a 2024-2025 task, so it was not yet adopted; the policy's published date is used.

The policy lists 'development of a detailed action plan' for the National Digital Transformation Strategy: Agenda 2030 as a 2024-2025 task, so none existed at its date; the policy's published date is used.
The policy gives its Chief Digital Office the task of developing and leading implementation of the Agenda 2030 strategy and has the statutory National Digital Advisory Council oversee it.

systems.country_label: National Digital Policy 2024 (National Digital Transformation Policy)
National Digital Transformation Strategy: Agenda 2035 (to be developed 2029-2030)

note: The policy is classed national: it is a whole-government framework with pillars for enabling environment, digital government, infrastructure, society and business, adopted by the Government. Agenda 2030 is classed national because the policy says it underpins implementation of that framework (2024-2030 phase); its own text is not described here. Reporting was not recorded: the policy only plans M&E mechanisms and annual reviews.
